welcomeDescription: Save places you’ve been. Make a wishlist for what’s next.
previewOnly: Just for fun. These won’t save to your map.
tapToStamp: Tap a country to stamp it.
remindersDescription: Mark new countries visited with a tap.
permissions: Uses notifications and “Always” location to spot arrivals in the background.
remindersOff: Reminders are off. Turn them on anytime in Settings.
saveError: Couldn’t save. Try again to continue.
